sections.title: Arsenal
sections.html:
Arsenal Women

  • Women's Super League · Arsenal 1–1 London City Lionesses

Arsenal and London City Lionesses drew 1–1, with Frida Maanum scoring in the 10th minute from Alessia Russo's assist and Isobel Goodwin replying a minute later, set up by Mapi León. Arsenal are sixth on 14 points, unbeaten in seven.

Next up

  • Sun 22 Nov, 10:30pm · West Ham United (home) · English Women's Super League
  • Sat 12 Dec, 3am · Everton (away) · English Women's Super League
